definitions.explanation: Thin strips of ginger pickled in plum vinegar, dyed a bright red color. Served as a topping for dishes such as gyudon, yakisoba, and okonomiyaki.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紅生姜|べにしょうが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせた。
examples.english: I put pickled red ginger on the gyudon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紅生姜|べにしょうが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Pickled red ginger is essential for yakisoba.

examples.japanese: {紅生姜|べにしょうが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧な⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彩|いろど}り→彩り：12506_irodori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The vivid red of the pickled ginger adds color to the dish.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{紅|べに}→紅：13862_beni⟧ (crimson) + ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧ (ginger). Bright red from being pickled in plum vinegar ({梅酢|うめず}).

COMMON USES (toppings):
- ⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧: gyudon (beef bowl)
- ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧: yakisoba
- ⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧: okonomiyaki
- ⟦たこ{焼|や}き→たこ焼き：10364_takoyaki⟧: takoyaki

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ガリ→ガリ：27408_gari⟧: thinly sliced pickled ginger served with sushi — pale pink or beige, milder and sweeter
- ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧: fresh ginger — the unpickled root
